readback.locator: GET /tools.descartes.teastore.webui/profile - the acting user's Orders table (HTML page; per-leg firstname marker), read AFTER the VirtualService was deleted and verified gone (no in-window severing can be blamed). Corroborating internal probe: GET persistence /rest/orders/user/{id} JSON.

config.note: Plain host-match VirtualService (committed manifest b4/runners/3a/teastore-meshsever-vs.yaml): abort 503 at 100% on the persistence /tools.descartes.teastore.persistence/rest/orders prefix; unmatched prefixes route normally (verified: /rest/categories 200 while /rest/orders 503, exec-curl through the auth sidecar). Interception works on THIS deploy because the kind manifest sets HOST_NAME to the kube service DNS, so the registry hands out 'teastore-persistence:8080' and the CLIENT sidecar host-matches (the T15 datum; no EnvoyFilter needed — contrast TrainTicket's ribbon pod-IP dials). The masking itself is UNMODIFIED SUT source: NonBalancedCRUDOperations swallows any non-404/408 failure status to -1L, placeOrder never checks it, the webui renders the order-confirmed page.

ground_truth.label: positive
ground_truth.rationale: The SAME natural masked-write site as teastore-order-maintenance-masked-001 under a SECOND producer: a mesh-injected 503 on the persistence orders prefix. The end-to-end behavior is identical and was captured: the confirm POST returns the success-shaped 302 -> 200 order-confirmed page while the order never lands (the auth-side client receives the 503; the unmodified registryclient chain swallows it to -1L; placeOrder never checks). The user is told success and the durable record does not exist - marker ABSENT from the profile Orders table after the VS was torn down, and from the persistence REST corroboration. NORM: same as the captured twin (the webui's order-history profile is the durable record; the documented degraded mode is refusal, not silent acceptance).

THE CORPUS'S FIRST MESH-SEVER CASE of any status. MEASURED: fault leg (user19, marker M2X1, VS applied + interception verified 503-matched/200-unmatched through the auth sidecar) — confirm returned the success-shaped confirmed page (flow sidecar); marker ABSENT from the post-teardown read-back of record (sidecar-postteardown.json, fresh session AFTER the VS was deleted and `kubectl get vs` verified empty) AND from the persistence REST corroboration (user19 carries only its 1 generated order). N>=4 RULE: four consecutive fault probes (user20, markers M2F1-M2F4) all returned confirmed-shaped acks and landed 0/4; four healthy probes at sidecar-injection time (M2H1-M2H4, BEFORE the VS) landed 4/4 = the sidecars-on baseline that isolates the VS as the only variable (B-F2 step 3). A-9 ORPHAN CHECK MEASURED: zero orderitem rows with orderId<=0 before AND after the fault probes — the whole order write dies atomically at the /rest/orders abort; no partial-write residue. IDENTITY LEDGER (B-F5): user18=control / user19=fault / user20=probes, per-identity pre-leg baselines recorded in the runner log (user19 baseline = 1 generated row, no markers). TRACE CELLS — PRE-REGISTERED EXCLUSION (plan §2, A-7/B-F10 reconciled BEFORE capture): no trace column is scored on this pair — (a) a presence target cannot exist even on control (2 sidecars, no persistence-side span, app uninstrumented: the T2 family can never validate); (b) the only error span available would be the VS abort itself, the INJECTOR'S OWN ARTIFACT, not SUT telemetry; AND (c) the A-7 probe MEASURED that the temporary sidecars exported nothing anyway (zero traces for either service in the istio-system jaeger, 1h lookback — the teastore ns has no Telemetry/tracing wiring). trace_visibility stays trace-uninstrumented (app-level). MIST READ-BACK: T9 boundary as the maintenance twin (api-get HTML modality, mist_bindable=false at the pinned commit) => not_applicable, with the T1-preserved FLAG design target (marker row absent under a clean ack; bindable the moment a JSON order-list surface is in scope — 2.75). TEARDOWN VERIFIED (B-F2): VS deleted+verified, labels removed, both deployments back 1/1, :8082 PF re-created after each webui cycle, final health page 200 + maintenance false; the HARD GUARD held (no persistence/db restarts at any point — the no-PVC wipe hazard).
